exam.title: NiCat IAP Pilot — 20 Marks
exam.instructions: Independent practice based on archived MMU course topics, not an official examination paper. Answer all 12 questions. MCQs earn 1 mark each; written answers are reviewed by staff.

sources.title: BCS 2218 Internet Application Programming Course Outline

questions.prompt: In an HTML form, which attribute identifies the URL that processes the submitted data?
questions.explanation: The form action attribute specifies the submission destination.

questions.prompt: What normally happens to form fields sent using the HTTP GET method?
options: They are appended to the URL query string
They are stored only in browser memory
They are converted to CSS rules
questions.explanation: GET form data is encoded in the URL query string; do not send secrets in it.

questions.prompt: Which form encoding is used when uploading files from an HTML form?
questions.explanation: Multipart form-data supports file uploads, unlike a normal URL-encoded form.

questions.prompt: How do HTML radio buttons normally form a group where selecting one clears the others?
options: Assign the same id to every input
questions.explanation: Radio inputs sharing a name in a form are treated as one choice group.

questions.prompt: In the rule p { color: red; }, what does p represent?
questions.explanation: The selector identifies the elements targeted by the CSS declaration.

questions.prompt: What is a key benefit of linking an external CSS file from multiple HTML pages?
options: It runs PHP on the browser
It allows consistent styling from one stylesheet
It removes the need for all HTML attributes
questions.explanation: An external stylesheet centralizes presentation rules for reuse and easier maintenance.

questions.prompt: Which JavaScript statement declares a named reusable function?
questions.explanation: The function keyword followed by an identifier, parentheses, and a body declares a named function.

questions.prompt: After declaring function greet() {}, which expression invokes the function?
questions.explanation: A declared function is called by its name followed by parentheses.

questions.prompt: Where is PHP code normally executed in a PHP web application?
questions.explanation: PHP is processed server-side before the resulting response is sent to the browser.

questions.section: Talking to MySQL Databases with SQL
questions.prompt: Which SQL statement is used to retrieve records from a MySQL table?
questions.explanation: SELECT retrieves records that match the query criteria.

questions.prompt: Describe the HTML elements and attributes needed for a feedback form that submits a learner email and a multi-line comment by POST to /feedback. Include how the fields and submit action are identified. (5 marks)
questions.explanation: A valid form includes an action, POST method, named email and textarea controls, plus a submission control and clear labels.

rubric.description: Includes an email input with an appropriate name attribute.
Includes a textarea with a name attribute for the comment.
Includes a submit button and labels or clear field descriptions.

questions.section: Purpose / Course Content (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and MySQL)
questions.prompt: A student association wants a website where visitors can fill in a registration form and administrators can view stored records. Explain the distinct roles HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL would play. (5 marks)
questions.explanation: HTML structures the interface, CSS styles it, JavaScript enables client behaviour, PHP processes requests server-side, and MySQL stores data.

rubric.description: Explains HTML structures the registration form and page content.
Explains CSS controls the presentation or layout.
Explains JavaScript supports client-side behaviour or validation.
Explains PHP handles server-side processing of submitted data.
Explains MySQL stores and retrieves registration records.
